description: This file defines messaging classes and templates for a software project, including a base category type, a text message class, and a macro for defining messaging categories.

classes.name: BaseCategoryType
classes.description: A template class representing a category type with associated text data.

classes.name: TextMessage
classes.description: A class implementing a text message, inheriting from Core::Messaging::IEvent, with serialization capabilities.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the text data of the message.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the text data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the message into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the message from a buffer.
